title: ADI Global Distribution to Participate in the Jefferies 2026 Industrials Conference
summary: MELVILLE, N.Y., August 27, 2026--ADI Global Distribution Inc. title: ADI Global Distribution Completes Spin-Off from Resideo Technologies and Begins Trading on the New York Stock Exchange
summary: MELVILLE, N.Y., August 04, 2026--ADI Global Distribution Inc. (NYSE: ADIG) ("ADI"), a leading global specialty distributor of low-voltage products, today announced the completion of its spin-off from Resideo Technologies, Inc. ("Resideo"), establishing ADI as an independent publicly traded company. ADI’s common stock will begin "regular way" trading today on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "ADIG".
